facts.value: Implements ten numbered command handlers over shared CommandInfo state and a bounded dispatcher. Handlers update the stream cursor, timer, loop/return storage, or invoke lbBgFlash_80021C48; Command_00 clears the cursor. Command_Execute dispatches only IDs 0 through 9.
facts.rationale: The previous continuation wording omits Command_00 stopping by clearing the cursor and presents sequential mutation too uniformly.

evidence.why: Complete module contains handler table, state-mutating callbacks, and bounded dispatcher.

facts.value: CommandInfo execution-context pointer forwarded unchanged to the selected callback for command IDs below ten. The dispatcher itself does not check this pointer; handlers require suitable state. Rejected IDs do not dereference it.
facts.rationale: Argument position and branch use are explicit in the canonical definition.

evidence.why: Shows parameter signature, index guard, callback argument and rejection path.
